research_target: daily treated effluent volume in m3, single day origin+h; existing facilities with finite initial modelling history

source_pseudo_validation.heldout_unit: one original source SiteID, all related physical measurements excluded if mapping becomes available

budget_design.definition: initial contiguous B calendar days [T-B,T-1] before first origin T; model, scale, bias, alpha and lambda then frozen for all 60 origins
budget_design.deployment_updates: newly known lagged volume and eligible lagged rainfall inputs only; no deployment labels used for fitting, adaptation, parameter selection or bias updates
budget_design.training_target_constraint: every training/adaptation target date <= initial calibration cutoff
budget_design.historical_day_end_cutoff: C(t)=confirmed end of TDV date t in provider-confirmed timezone; currently UNKNOWN, no substitution of local UTC midnight without evidence
budget_design.initial_feature_left_boundary: no lagged volume or rainfall interval before initial history left boundary; unavailable features are masked, no warm-up observations outside B
budget_design.h3_label_definition: volume on calendar date origin+3, not 3-day cumulative volume

quality.volume_rules: Stage3B frozen QA-v3: finite Good nonnegative nonconflicting m3 for inputs and truth; Missing including zero, Suspect, Good-negative and conflicting days masked
quality.rain_negative_nonfinite_conflict_or_miss: invalid; never treat omitted value or missing interval as zero precipitation

volume_features.values: three allowed nonnegative QA volume values / positive-median volume scale; missing normalized value=0 only alongside availability mask
volume_features.masks: one availability indicator for each volume lag

rain_features.candidate_product: Environment Agency hydrology historical Qualified 15-minute rainfall series, exact version and archived bytes to be frozen before execution
rain_features.window_formula: [C(t)-72h,C(t)-48h), using verified interval bounds; interval endpoint membership follows provider semantics, no naive timestamp assumption
rain_features.value: sum of all 96 valid consecutive non-overlapping 15-minute amounts, divided by rain scale fitted only on allowed training-period complete windows
rain_features.availability_mask: 1 iff the entire 24h window is valid, complete, inside allowed history and ends before information cutoff; else 0 and normalized numeric placeholder=0
rain_features.partial_total: not accepted as a complete rainfall total; no extrapolation, future filling or future actual rainfall
rain_features.rain_scale: median strictly positive complete 24h amounts in allowed training-only history; fallback=1mm if no positive amount; local/internal validation fits prefix only; full calibration fits initial B only; source model fits permitted source period only
rain_features.timezone_and_endpoint_semantics: UNVERIFIED; current hydrology sample dateTime is naive. Do not copy UTC claims from a different API or infer endpoint from spelling
rain_features.historical_first_publication: UNVERIFIED; Qualified archive usable only as explicitly retrospective observations unless historical as-of records are obtained

rain_spatial_mapping.proxy_allowed_after_review: dated verified historical plant-point location is a point rain-gauge spatial proxy; historically verified sewer-catchment geometry may support a prespecified gauge proxy but is not catchment-average rainfall
rain_spatial_mapping.station_selection_rule_draft: after dated formal coordinates/crosswalk obtained, eligible stable rainfall series must satisfy 2016-2021 complete-window quality/coverage >=95% in each year; choose ascending historical proxy-to-gauge distance, tie stable series URI. Fix gauge ledger before 2022-2023 model evaluation; no choice by volume-model error or observed 2023 sample missingness
rain_spatial_mapping.gauge_change_rule: no replacement because current sample is missing or future deployment score is poor; a formally corrected historical mapping requires documented evidence and a new reviewed freeze before any scores

fitting.ridge_objective: weighted MSE + alpha * squared coefficient norm; intercept unpenalized, weights sum to one
fitting.residual_target: r(t,h)=y(t+h)-p(t,h), p is exact same legal Persistence used in evaluation; normalized by permitted volume scale
fitting.forecast: p(t,h) + lambda * volume_scale * (normalized residual estimate + allowed normalized local bias)
fitting.local_bias: 0 for local residual family; shared bias=mean allowed calibration residual error, internal validation prefix only
fitting.selection: legal normalized validation MAE joint alpha/lambda; tie smaller lambda then smaller alpha; no deployment loss tie-break
fitting.B90_B180_validation: last 20% calendar holdout within initial history; purge train labels crossing validation boundary; prefix-only volume/rain normalization and bias; min 30 fit labels and 10 validation labels
fitting.B30_validation: same source-assisted pseudo-deployment folds used fairly by matching local/shared and volume/rain versions; disclose source-assisted local hyperparameters, not a purely source-free local baseline
fitting.weather_variant_tuning: each volume/rain variant may select from identical fixed grid using only identical legal folds; pair changes reflect weather features plus legally selected finite coefficients, no extra grid
fitting.secondary_prediction_constraint: uniform max(0,prediction) for all five methods, retain both predictions

evaluation.primary_window_set: all five already-used development windows, combined by matched daily MAE within each SiteID; original four vs October separately secondary
evaluation.primary_window_aggregation: for each fixed budget/horizon/comparison, concatenate that SiteID's matched valid origin-target conditions from all five already-used windows, compute paired MAE over those dates and then the SiteID skill; aggregate the ten SiteID skills with equal weights. Do not average five windows as independent facilities or pool volume totals across SiteIDs
evaluation.per_window_analysis: exploratory only, including October2023; no window is claimed as untouched or independent temporal/facility validation
evaluation.repeated_condition_unit_rule: SiteID remains the sole cluster label; repeated dates, origin-target conditions, budgets, horizons and windows do not create additional independent facilities. Calculate each budget/horizon comparison separately; no averaging repeat conditions to invent extra samples
evaluation.secondary_delta_persistence_skill: report skill(rain,Persistence)-skill(volume,Persistence) separately; do not conflate it with 1-MAE_rain/MAE_volume
evaluation.date_matching: all five policies and all three budgets on same legal target/evaluation dates, matching Stage3B common index where comparable; missing rain remains feature mask and never silently removes target dates
evaluation.zero_reference_MAE: explicit undefined skill and count, no silent division or exclusion; publish absolute MAE/RMSE and affected comparisons
reports: shared-rain vs matched local-rain negative transfer
rain vs no-rain within each family
rain feature completeness and missing/failed predictions
evaluation.high_volume: exploratory only; Stage3B initial first-30-calendar-day valid volume Q90 threshold for every budget, same threshold and matched dates, no future-valued model selector or capacity claim
evaluation.budget_efficiency: secondary shared30 vs local90/180 and shared90 vs local180 with identical input scenario; do not equate weak-local gains with practical deployment benefit

uncertainty.blocks: noncircular calendar blocks within each fixed 60-origin window, preserving missing positions; same block draw for all SiteIDs and methods; resample whole SiteID clusters as Stage3B audited implementation
uncertainty.cross_window_block_construction: stratify the five original 60-origin calendar windows; construct and sample blocks separately inside each original window, then combine resampled losses within SiteID for its MAE/skill. Never construct a block spanning a gap or by concatenating noncontinuous windows
uncertainty.limits: 10 development SiteIDs are not verified independent plants; shared weather and repeatedly used windows limit generalization; seeds/dates/budgets are not independent facilities

activation_gates.requirement: 10/10 target and 3/3 source dated normal-TDV/plant point or explicitly justified historical spatial proxy; no substitution of storm-overflow points or unverified 2025 boundaries
provider-confirmed TDV statistics interval/timezone and calendar day-end information-cutoff convention
official timezone and actual cumulative interval start/end for selected 15-minute series, including DST and naive timestamp treatment
fixed series cover permitted 2016-2021 source training and causal pseudo-validation at prespecified complete-window threshold; preserve missing periods and invalid values
review accepts final Qualified archive only as retrospective scenario if no historical first-publication/revision evidence; lag2 is not a proven release guarantee
user review, exact data/gauge/config/code hashes, aligned-date correctness checks and one small two-SiteID replay before scientific full run

success_failure_and_stop.do_not_execute_until: all activation gates passed and reviewed; current execute_allowed remains false
success_failure_and_stop.statistical_support: all four primary 14-day 98.75% CI lower bounds >0, no failed primary configuration, at least90% common valid target coverage; positive exploratory alternative cannot replace primary method
success_failure_and_stop.negative_evidence: upper CI <=0 for any main comparison is evidence against that comparison under this development design; point estimate <=0 is reported as no observed mean benefit
success_failure_and_stop.uncertain: CI crosses0 means unresolved, not equivalence; not all four successes means overall prespecified joint support not established
success_failure_and_stop.engineering_effect_threshold: UNKNOWN_PENDING_DOMAIN_INPUT; statistical support alone cannot establish practical usefulness
success_failure_and_stop.hard_stop: after one fixed finite round; preserve all negative/fallback/failure results; do not expand gauges, source pool, sites, windows, models or alpha/lambda search to chase positive results
success_failure_and_stop.invalid_boundary: halt on future rain/input access, training labels past cutoff, normalization/bias using validation labels, known physical source-target overlap or mismatched dates; preserve failures and correct all compared methods in a new version before interpretation

independent_target_reservation.requirements: provider official dated physical groups and existing protected-target register first; exclude 3 source/10 used-development groups and all siblings; reserve20% of verified eligible never-used groups by predefined hash before source expansion, subject to M>=20

source_pool_scale_alternative.priority: not concurrent; only propose if rain blocked and physical groups/target reservation become verified

future_data_volume_order_of_magnitude.source_formula: 3 source point series * 6 years * 365 days * 96 intervals/day
future_data_volume_order_of_magnitude.development_formula: up to10 development point series * 2 years * 365 days * 96 intervals/day
future_data_volume_order_of_magnitude.interpretation: about1.33million logical point-interval records, not an observed download count; shared rain series can be deduplicated and missing intervals reduce returned records
future_data_volume_order_of_magnitude.omitted_boundaries: leap days and extra2021 target rain intervals required by first-window initial B=180 history omitted; calculate exact fixed-gauge/window request ledger before fetching
future_data_volume_order_of_magnitude.future_acquisition_rule: approved fixed source/gauge/date ledger only; paginate with explicit per-request row/byte limits, persist raw response and SHA256, resume verified cache; no unrelated bulk download
